# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is currently a placeholder until we have content to add. This will be a Quarto book on the topic of Community-Engaged Statistics and Data Sciences courses. The handbook will detail how to design and implement these courses at your institution from building relationships to assessment of student work. 

Read about the work on the [website](https://community-engaged-stats-ds.github.io/CESDS_website/)!

Check back to learn more!

To learn more about Quarto books visit <https://quarto.org/docs/books>.
